R2.3.scope: Expose read-only byte spans for simple top-level frontmatter property keys and raw values, without YAML interpretation or source modification.
acceptance: Top-level simple keys and raw values are identified by byte offsets into the original UTF-8 document.
Whitespace around values and trailing YAML comments are excluded from the value span; comment markers inside quoted or flow values remain part of the value.
Indented child entries are omitted and blank values have empty spans.
Malformed or absent frontmatter yields no property spans.
Focused Rust unit tests and all required Rust/companion CI gates pass on the exact pushed SHA.
